description: Ajay Sarkar, a lower middle-class man pretends to be a successful businessman in order to win the hand of Monica, a girl from an affluent family.

Title: 622. Grande Sertão
description: Cowboy Riobaldo is attracted to same sex Diadorim, not knowing that "he" is a girl dressed in man's clothes. After Diadorim's father is killed, she swears revenge, being joined by Riobaldo in this mission.

Title: 623. Le coup de grâce
description: During WWII, Bruno has given many people away to the Gestapo. Now, 25 years after, with a new face given by plastic surgery, he is back and becomes friend with his victims' relatives or friends.

Title: 624. O Trigo e o Joio
description: A sad and strong people living in the huge plains of Alentejo. Their endless struggle for bread, their nostalgic, bewitching songs and their daily toil to turn a dry, barren land into golden wheat fields.

Title: 625. Questo pazzo, pazzo mondo della canzone
description: Thirty Italian singers from the sixties sing their hits.

Title: 626. Vereda de Salvação
description: In the poor Brazil's Northeast, rural laborers join in a messianic group led by Joaquim, who believes to be the reincarnation of Jesus Christ. Gaining power over the peasants, he begins to persecute those who does not pay absolute obeisance to him.

Title: 627. Skjær i sjøen
description: After his divorce, a lone writer receives a summer visit from his daughter and two of her friends. He has for far too long revolved around his own problems falling into dull idleness. But not so old that he can't be touched by young love.

Title: 628. Clay
description: A killer on the run is found lying flat on his face in a wet clay bank. He is rescued by potters who shelter him within their community. There he falls in love with a woman. Unfortunately, another man who has been calling upon the woman gets jealous and turns the fugitive in to the cops. The woman gets revenge.

Title: 629. Zatoichi and the Chess Expert
description: A samurai with a high skill in chess makes friends with Zatoichi, who finds that things become peculiar in his presence.

Title: 630. Tunnel Warfare
description: Chinese excavated a lot of tunnels in middle Hebei flatlands and fight invaders in these tunnels in the anti-Japanese war.

Title: 631. Hotel der toten Gäste
description: Hotel detective Janos Kovacs travels from San Remo, where the Schlagerfestival will soon be held, to London. He wants to sell critical information to the crime reporter Barney Blair. Before Barney arrives, Kovacs is stabbed.

Title: 632. Operation Atlantis
description: An American agent discovers that the Red Chinese have built a secret atomic city from which they will attempt to invade America.

Title: 634. Goldsinger
description: The diabolical Goldsinger, enraged at being excluded from the UN, hatches a plot to blow up the assembly while all the heads of the state participate. Luckily, inept agent James Tont discovers the plot and sets out to stop Goldsinger.

Title: 635. The Battle of the Bulge... The Brave Rifles
description: Hitler's last offensive in 1944 in the Ardennes, with which he desperately tried to stop the allies thereof, to reach Antwerp.

Title: 636. The Restless Ones
description: A reporter doing a story on a Christian pastor who ministers to troubled teens doesn't realize that his own son is getting mixed up with a disturbed young girl and that both of them are headed for trouble.

Title: 637. Menage all'italiana
description: In Italy in the 60's it is difficult to get a divorce. Carlo gets a visit from his Swedish wife, but he is already remarried. Every time he meets a new woman, he vanishes away from the last wife.

Title: 639. Mrtvacima ulaz zabranjen
description: The main protagonist is a modest teacher who is getting involved in the clash of two criminal gangs.

Title: 640. Arshin mal alan
description: In early 20th-century Baku, wealthy merchant Asgar disguises himself as a traveling cloth seller to meet women and find a bride, leading to comic complications when he falls in love with Gulchohra.

Title: 641. Go Go Mania
description: No plot here, just a collection of lip-synched videos from some of the bands that were part of the "British Invasion" in 1964: The Animals, Herman's Hermits, Peter and Gordon, and the Spencer Davis Group (with Steve Winwood). The film also features bookend live performances by The Beatles.

Title: 642. El niño y el muro
description: Not realizing the dangers he is facing, Young Dieter will do anything to get his ball back after it was thrown over the Berlin wall by a ruthless guard.

Title: 643. Neobycejná trída
description: The last grade of the twelve-year secondary school is attended only by girls. At school, they have turned famous for the mischief they get into but their class-teacher Kotková likes them and watches both their joys and distresses with understanding. The girls' production training takes place in a vast machine-tool factory, where they sometimes have conflicts with the leading master, whom they nickname Grouch. At school, the girls suspect the Czech language teacher Krivka of unjust marking.

Title: 644. Himalay Ki Godmein
description: Young doctor chooses remote Himalayan village, abandoning city comforts. Fiancée leaves, dismayed by primitive conditions. He must decide: stay to heal the villagers or follow his heart.

Title: 645. Fort Courageous
description: An ex-cavalry sergeant, being escorted to prison after being convicted of a crime he didn't commit, finds himself leading the remnants of a unit that has been under Indian attack at a fort. The commanding officer has been killed, the Indians vastly outnumber them, and the only bargaining chip they have is the fact that they have captured the Indian chief's son.

Title: 646. Qarun's Treasure
description: When two young poor men save a rich man who has decided to suicide and take care of him, he learns about the other part of the society and poor people's life.

Title: 647. Les copains
description: Seven pals decide to take a few days'holidays to free up the time necessary to pull three enormous pranks. Their aim is to ridicule three established bodies: the army, the church and the administration. Quite arbitrarily, they set their hearts on two peaceful sub-prefectures, Ambert and Issoire. Broudier, disguised as a government minister, turns up at the barracks, demands and obtains the organization of night maneuvers. The following day, Bénin, dressed up as a reverend, preaches in the cathedral of Issoire a sermon against the precepts of the Church. As for Lesueur, he disturbs the inauguration of the statue of Vercingétorix by an MP. But the holidays are over. The seven of them can'r part without a last joke...

Title: 648. Skies Above
description: The crew of an aircraft carrier discovers that it is being pursued by a UFO that turns out to be a radioactive probe from outer space. They appeal to the warring countries of Earth to stop fighting and help it to repel the invaders.

Title: 649. Mere Sanam
description: Neena, in the company of her mom, and several female friends, travels to a remote holiday spot, and stay overnight at a lodge. A young man named Kumar also attends at this lodge, claiming to be the owner, and asking the caretaker, Shyam, to get rid of the intruders. Shyam assures Kumar that he will do so immediately. Instead of asking them to leave, he tells the visitors that Kumar is mentally unstable, and believes that he owns this lodge. After several misunderstandings, Kumar and Neena fall in love, and want to get married. And it is then Neena and her mother are come across photographs of Kumar and a young woman named Kamo alias Kamini, in very intimate positions.

Title: 650. Not Reconciled
description: An entangled story which details the lives of a German family throughout their various generations.

Title: 651. Two Sergeants of General Custer
description: During the civil war, two Union soldiers of Sicilian origin, Ciccio and Franco, are imprisoned and accused of desertion. The luck suddenly is on their side when the Union army needs two perfect idiots in a spy operation.

Title: 652. The Girl
description: A WW2 love story between a village girl and a partisan. A personal views on war are seen through the eyes of the two above, the local photographer, and German officer.

Title: 653. Beauty #2
description: A couple disports in chimerical role-playing as part of their concours de seduction.

Title: 654. I've Gotta Horse
description: A fast-moving comedy with Billy Fury, who plays himself in the film. The story reveals his great love of animals, and it features his own racehorse, Anselmo.

Title: 655. Los Tales por cuales
description: Los tales por cuales. Llega un ranchero acusado por varios delitos a cuidar a un Cacique de un pueblo con un brillante y desenlace.

Title: 657. Una bella grinta
description: A man is beset by financial and personal problems, as his business goes bankrupt and he finds out his wife is being unfaithful. Undeterred, he battles on and his determination carries the day.

Title: 658. Ladies and Gentlemen, Mr. Leonard Cohen
description: National Film Board of Canada Donald Owen teamed with NFB producer Donald Brittain for an imaginative profile of Montreal poet Leonard Cohen.

Title: 659. Los fantasmas burlones
description: The ghosts of Francoise and Louis are invoked by accident from beyond by a scam artist called El Ojitos, who, along with El Manitas, attempt to take advantage of the presence of the ghosts in order to marry their girlfriends.

Title: 660. If I Were Harap Alb
description: Lavish live action fairy tale adaptation featuring the handsome son of a nobleman who embarks on a series of colorful adventures to become a hero.

Title: 661. Rita, la figlia americana
description: Professor Serafino Benvenuti is a master of classical music who has the passion of the orchestra director. However, the young audience of the 1960s does not appreciate classical composers like Mozart or Beethoven, so Serafino is likely to have compromised his image as a director.

Title: 662. Master of Horror
description: An anthology film of two classic tales from Edgar Allan Poe. A re-edited and dubbed version of Masterworks of Terror (1960) for American cinemas.

Title: 663. Taylor Mead's Ass
description: Taylor Mead bares his ass.

Title: 664. Tintansón CruZoe
description: Tin-Tan Cruz, a taxi driver who is accused of stealing money from tourists, escapes to an island where men are prisoners of god Mio Mao and women are ruled by wicked king Soleto.

Title: 665. The Children That I Dreamed
description: A mature woman lives alone and a priest asks her to house a group of children who have been orphaned.

Title: 666. Me ha gustado un hombre
description: Una muchacha, desesperada por huir de la policia, se viste de hombre y se hace pasar por empleado de un hotel. Todo parece ir bien, hasta que un huésped se empieza a encariñar con ella, lo que le causa gran conflicto porque cree que se ha enamorado de un hombre.

Title: 667. O nikitis
description: Petros and Lena have known and loved each other since they were little children. But her parents oppose their relationship.

Title: 668. Ek Sapera Ek Lutera
description: Twins are separated at birth but grow up to rival each other for a woman both have fallen in love with.

Title: 669. Teesra Kaun
description: A man goes on the run after being accused of stealing diamonds from the future in-laws of his sister.

Title: 670. Kiri no hata
description: Kiriko attempts to hire a well-known lawyer to defend her brother's murder case. The lawyer turns Kiriko down as she cannot afford him. Some time later, Kiriko encounters the lawyer again, but this time it is he who needs her help.

Title: 671. Neela Akash
description: Neela and Akash fall in love with each other after a comedy of errors. They manage to stay together in spite of all the obstacles.

Title: 672. Identification Marks: None
description: After being drafted into military service, a Polish student spends his last day coming to terms with his estranged wife, visiting old friends, and savoring some last moments of freedom.

Title: 673. Akutô
description: A morally-suspect and self-serving retainer rashly baits her high-ranking employer, a regional governor, with a salacious story of a former acquaintance and catastrophe ensues.

Title: 674. Passer passer piger
description: Monalisa is supposed to accommodate 6 beauty queens. Unfortunately, all the city's hotels are full and she must ask her janitor to help her persuade the tenants in her building to take in the women.

Title: 676. The Koumiko Mystery
description: While filming the Olympics, a filmmaker encounters a Japanese girl. Manchurian born and French educated, she's an intriguing anomaly. He films her around Tokyo, as she speaks of Japan, being Japanese and her unique perspective on life.

Title: 677. La familia y... uno más
description: Over the years, the life of the disproportionate family of Carlos Alonso has undergone several changes: the birth of little María, the sixteenth child, coincided with the death of the mother, who left behind her an irreparable gap. The grandfather has also died. The pastry godfather has been married, and the boys have been growing rapidly.

Title: 678. Summer Children
description: A brooding adonis, driven by his jealous infatuation for an ethereal beauty competes for alpha male dominance in this stylistic 1960's neo-noir (B&W) European style film.

Title: 679. Goliath at the Conquest of Damascus
description: The legendary strong man, Goliath, goes through a series of harrowing adventures as he helps an exiled king regain his throne.

Title: 680. De kalte ham Skarven
description: About a fisherman who has to face judgment on his life after an accident.

Title: 681. Ko mne, Mukhtar!
description: Mukhtar comes to live and work at the police kennels through rather unusual circumstances. Together with his handler, Glazychev, Mukhtar helps to solve large and small crimes.

Title: 682. La criada malcriada
description: Azucena is a saucy maid whose personality causes many comical situations. These will increase when the family she works for hosts a recently widowed millionaire returning to Puerto Rico after many years.

Title: 683. Nude Scrapbook
description: A "girlie" photographer going through his scrapbook reminisces about all of the beautiful women he's photographed.

Title: 684. The Secret Society
description: We take you inside some of the most unusual sex clubs the world had ever known. On the east side of town, a group of out of state businessmen wait patiently for the girls to arrive. One of the men, a member of a national sex club known only as the "Secret Society," has made a call to the club's central office, and has requested an evening's entertainment. Being a member in good standing, his desires were not denied. the society flipped through its catalogue of perversions and arrived at the names office young ladies, three of whom were married, who, themselves society members were available for Friday night orgies. The girls receive no money for their services, for they, like the men, are only interested in an evening's entertainment. All that is really necessary is that you continue to pay your monthly dues to the "Secret Society." The society's main activities range from the production and distribution of out-and-out stag movies to the scheduling of abortions. This film shows this sex club in a cold realistic light that your customers will enjoy. Making wide use of hidden cameras, the producers have brought to the screen an exceptionally accurate account of the nation's wildest sin syndicate.

Title: 685. El mamalik
description: After suffering Egyptians from the oppression of the Mamluks and despotism clump the people and organize popular resistance to eliminate them and get rid of the ruling Circassians and the commander of his bodyguards Aybak, joins Alhabiban Ahmad and Qamar resistance despite suffering colors they receive, designed Ahmed to avenge the death of his mother on their hands, achieved guerrilla dream he is condemned the country's young people from Egyptians are free.

Title: 686. Tu Hi Meri Zindagi
description: A patriot shouted "Freedom is my birthright!" and vowed to break bondage's shackles. This spirit inspired our hero. Rocky, from a family of freedom fighters, avenged his love's death and joined revolution to liberate Goa from Portuguese.

Title: 687. Historias de la televisión
description: Film divided into two stories: 1. Cuando los gorilas hablan por teléfono 2. Una chica de fortuna

Title: 688. Il morbidone
description: Study of a man whose basic sense of inferiority leads him from worse to worse.

Title: 689. Poor Little Rich Girl
description: A young, jobless woman stays in bed, reads, talks on the phone, smokes cigarettes, makes fresh coffee, and tries on some clothes from a large wardrobe.

Title: 690. Samba
description: Brazilian singer Laura Monteiro is murdered in her dressing-room by her jealous lover João Fernandes de Oliveira when he discovered she was cheating on his with Assis and planning to escape from him and go to Buenos Aires with Assis. Meanwhile, Belén Moreira, who lives in Favela do Salgueiro and is a dead ringer for Laura, goes to Copacabana with her boyfriend Paulo. Two members of a gang that smuggles precious stones sewn in Carnival costumes see Belén and force the President of the Salgueiro Samba School to invite her to perform Chica da Silva in the Carnival parade in a costume that is adorned with genuine precious stones to be smuggled to Europe.

Title: 691. The Bus
description: The struggle for civil rights has been one of the most important issues of American life for the last fifty years. In August of 1963, groups from all over the country journeyed to Washington D.C. for a massive demonstration, and this film is a fascinating document of this event. Celebrated filmmaker Haskell Wexler ("Medium Cool") traveled with the San Francisco delegation, photographing and conversing candidly with the participants. He has succeeded admirably in capturing the significance and drama of this historic trip.

Title: 692. Maciste il vendicatore dei Maya
description: Hercules fights for the Mayans.

Title: 693. El zurdo
description: The Left-Handed (1965). A man is given the responsibility for raising the son of a man who he killed.

Title: 694. Miyamoto Musashi V: Duel at Ganryu Island
description: The fifth and final installment with the build up of the epic battle between Sasaki Kojiro and Miyamoto Musashi. With all the familiar characters making appearances: Otsu (Musashi's great love), Akemi, Matahachi (his former fellow soldier), old lady Osugi (still doggedly trying to defeat Musashi), and even the return of Priest Takuan (the man responsible for his journey towards enlightenment). But most of all, the boastful, long-haired and long-sworded Sasaki Kojiro.

Title: 695. The Farmer's Other Daughter
description: Farmer Brown tries to save his farm by selling his daughter to Cyrus P. Barksnapper, but encounters a mix-up with government aid.

Title: 696. Morianna
description: Millionaire and tyrant Verner Vade, despised and hated by everyone, controls his employees, and his family of messy, perverted, promiscuous relations with an iron fist.

Title: 697. Sevgili Ögretmenim
description: The story of students who fell in love with their teachers.

Title: 698. Sandy the Seal
description: A lighthouse keeper's family shelters an injured seal, uncovering a sinister seal poaching operation in their coastal town. They vow to stop the criminals and protect the seals.

Title: 699. To remali tis Fokionos Negri
description: With his gambling debts piling up, devilishly handsome Alekos, a compulsive gambler living on the fringes of society, sets his sights on seducing a lonely and guileless heiress to get his hands on her immense fortune.

Title: 700. Poonam Ki Raat
description: Prakash and Chandan are enjoying their college trip with with their friends when Sumer Singh arrives with the news that Chandan's father is unwell and his mother has asked him to rush home.Paraksh who wants to slip from flirty Rekha accompanies Chandan to his house to provide him moral support.On the way Prakash finds out that the mansion he is going is haunted by a spirit of a women named Rani who was suspected to be murdered by Lala Bajinath.

Title: 701. Vaaksa vaaraa
description: An employee of a telephone company gets caught up in a criminal gang's intrigue.

Title: 702. Loca juventud
description: A millionaire 's son becomes a gondolier.

Title: 704. Saturday Night in Apple Valley
description: A big-city developer moves into a peaceful little valley, intending to buy up all the land and turn it into a gambling mecca, but the local residents have other ideas.

Title: 706. Lastik Man
description: See 'Lastik Man' transform himself into a thousand and one shapes. See 'Lastik Man' combat crime, experience the ultimate in thrills.

Title: 707. The Sword of Ali Baba
description: As the Mongols invade Baghdad in 1258 the Caliph escapes the city and heads to Basra with his young son, Ali. The Mongols catch the Caliph and he is killed but his son evades capture. In the desert Ali finds the hideout of the only resistance force, the forty thieves, and he joins them and grows up as one of them. Meanwhile his betrothed, the fair daughter of Prince Kasim, is taken to Baghdad by her father to be married to the Mongol leader, Hulago Khan. Ali goes to Baghdad and captures her but soon sets her free. She learns that he is her betrothed as well as the leader of the band of thieves. Her wedding to the Khan is set for Ramadan and so Ali Baba and his band of thieves must attend the celebrations and free the princess and Baghdad.

Title: 708. Temple of the Red Lotus
description: Jimmy Wang Yu plays a young kid who heads off to Dragon Valley to meet the childhood friend who was promised as his bride. When he gets there, he finds that the family of the bride might not be an entirely honest bunch of people though. What is the story behind their feud with the monks at the Temple Of The Red Lotus, for a start?

Title: 709. Kuzhandaiyum Deivamum
description: Twins, who were separated at birth, reunite to bring together their divorced parents.

Title: 710. A King's Story
description: Life story of King Edward VIII from his birth until abdication in 1936. Talks of life in Victorian England, life in the Royal Navy, and travels as Prince of Wales. In-depth look into the abdication Crisis of 1936. Includes interviews with His Royal Highness The Duke of Windsor and The Duchess of Windsor. Also has many films of the former King from his early childhood through his short reign.

Title: 711. When Tomorrow Dies
description: A frustrated, despairing housewife and young mother of two, imprisoned by her domestic world and ignored by her succesful husband, becomes increasingly bereft of hope and a means of escape.

Title: 712. The Rider of the Skulls
description: A masked rider (El Charro de las Calaveras - 'Rider of the Skulls') protects rural Mexicans from a werewolf, a vampire and a headless horseman, with the aid of his trusty pubescent sidekick Perico (Gabriel Agras Natchez).

Title: 713. The Girl and the Playboy
description: A millionaire suffers from amnesia after a hit to the head and now he has to rediscover his past and decide what kind of man he wants to be in the future.

Title: 714. Mäeküla piimamees
description: A baron gives a poor peasant a well-paid job of a milkman but for reward he has to accept his beloved girl going to mansion time to time. Does the wealth outweigh the honor and conscience?

Title: 715. L'avventuriero della Tortuga
description: (1964) Guy Madison, Nadia Gray, Rik Battaglia. In the New World, a rugged pirate leader and a corrupt governor vie for the affections of a beautiful Indian heiress. She falls in love with the pirate and together they annihilate the governor and his forces. Color, 16mm.

Title: 716. Blue Demon: El Demonio Azul
description: A professor challenges a mad scientist who turns himself into a werewolf.

Title: 717. Naughty Nudes
description: A group of young female artists pose for each other as nude models.

Title: 718. Yankesicinin aski
description: Osman and Hacer are two pickpockets who are in love. Their life changes as the rich Talat Acikel is dead. Talat leaves most of his assets to his granddaughter Nalan and the rest to his staff under one condition, Nalan must marry the son of his elder brother. Osman (the son) gets ready to marry Hacer and refuses the proposal. Osman's father gives his ID to Sekip to start the marriage preparations. Osman finds himself married to Nalan which makes Hacer furious. Osman tells Nazli everything. Nalan doesn't know about their marriage. It's all Sekip's plan. With the attorney's insisting, Osman convinces Nazli to stay married. Nalan falls in love with her. Hacer starts working at a night club. Osman asks for her pardon and tells Nazli he wants a divorce. Nalan accepts it only for him to be happy, she gives him a share from the inheritance and the little house in the garden. Hacer and Osman live happily forever .

Title: 719. Die Herren
description: The young journalist Eveline practice an extravagant life, when it comes to the opposite sex. She has dated street smart boys and manipulative businessman. They all think they are smarter than Eveline.

Title: 720. Mahabharat
description: A dynastic struggle between the collateral branches of the Kuru clan, the Kauravas and Pandavas, for the throne of Hastinapur leads to the Kurukshetra War.

Title: 721. Les fêtes galantes
description: In the 18th century, as the army of Prince De Beaulieu lays siege on the fortress of Marechal D'Allenberg, a young princess sends a soldier out of the fortress to go find her lover.

Title: 722. Hiçkirik
description: Kenan is brought up by his foster father, Azmi Bey. As he grows up, he falls in love with Azmi Bey's beautiful daughter Nalan. Nalan is diagnosed by Pleurisy, which leads to a series of tragic event.

Title: 723. Ich kauf mir lieber einen Tirolerhut
724. Tarzan and King Kong
description: A jungle queen captures the survivors of a plane crash, planning to sacrifice them to the goddess Bali. Tarzan intervenes and in the process falls in love with one of the stranded passengers.

Title: 725. A Man's Crest: We Kill
description: As a drifter Yakuza boss who might as well walk on water by all the good deeds he does and always trying non-violent/honorable solutions first...gets to finally draw his blade and get in touch with his old friend, Murder.

Title: 726. Karla
description: An idealistic teacher is shocked to discover her pupils are already cynical and opportunistic. Her colleague soon grows resentful when she uses new and challenging techniques to help her students overcome obstacles.

Title: 727. One Way Pendulum
description: A Briton and his eccentric family engage in a variety of bizarre pastimes.

Title: 728. Amor amor amor
description: Three stories with women as protagonists. Postmodern tales of desire, lust, death and shame. First attempts of Mexican cinema to left behind the grandiloquent nationalistic "golden epoch".

Title: 731. Doc, Hands of Steel
description: While being pursued by a bounty hunter, Doc, a gambler, accidentally sees bandits killing a sheriff. Doc pretends to be the sheriff so the bounty hunter will stop his chase. The bandits however still believe the sheriff is alive.

Title: 732. The Mermaid
description: A Huangmei opera about a carp spirit who transforms into an identical copy of a beautiful woman to win the heart of a lonely male scholar.

Title: 733. Un amore
description: The love life of an aging architect used to love affairs with call girls, who in the end settles down with a girl of his class but still longs for the life he has led so far, which ends in disillusion.

Title: 734. Fistful of Knuckles
description: Franco and Ciccio mosey into the Mexican border town of Santa Genoviefa. Both are dressed in ponchos, one rides a small mule, one a large one. They are gun salesmen, peddling their wares from town to town.

Title: 735. The Double Bed
description: Five comedic sketches of various adventures and misadventures.

Title: 736. An Empty Dream
description: A young man and a woman come to know each other while at the dentists's office. They are put under anesthesia and in the unconsciousness they fall in a love triangle with the dentist as if in a dream. In the extremity of happiness and misfortune, they experience the transcendence of time and space and are able to fulfill their lust. As a result, the affair is completely ruined. Wailing in great regret, they at last come to consciousness and reality.

Title: 737. Nobody Wanted to Die
description: 1947 year. Armed gangs are still hiding in Lithuanian forests. One after another, four village council chairmen were killed. Now old Lokis is dead. At the funeral, his four sons swear to destroy the Brownie gang. And Vaitkus, a former "forest brother", was forcibly put in place of Lokis.

Title: 738. Tell Me in the Sunlight
description: On the coast of Nassau in the Bahamas, an American cargo sailor on leave picks up a beautiful exotic dancer for a casual fling, but falls in love with her in spite of having just met her. She seems to feel the same way for him, but she already has a boyfriend. This leads to an awkward and unpredictable love triangle that could become dangerous.

Title: 739. Ang Mananandata
description: Filmed entirely in Eastman color - on location in the rugged highlands of Central Luzon.

Title: 740. Gaudeamus igitur
description: Five young high school graduates are preparing for college admissions in one of the largest and most important university centers, Cluj. Once they become students, the lives of the five change, and the results will be commensurate with the work of each.

Title: 741. Murappennu
description: Balan loses his rightful bride to his brother's deceit. When his cousin's groom abandons her for another wedding, a desperate Balan forces him back to marry her—only to find she has already tragically ended her life.

Title: 742. La vida nueva de Pedrito de Andía
description: Pedrito de Andia is an adolescent who is self-conscious about his height. He is in love with his childhood friend Isabel and goes to the port looking forward to welcoming her after her long stay abroad.

Title: 743. Nu hai qing chou
description: The son of the town bully lusts after a local beauty in this action-filled thriller of the passions and violence to be found in a fishing village.

Title: 745. Sapang palay
description: Now it can be told, the story you've heard and read so much about, the raw, rugged realism of life - fighting a place in the world.

Title: 747. La congiuntura
description: Don Giuliano Niccolini Borges (Vittorio Gassman), Roman Prince and member of the Pontifical Noble Guard, is very much attracted to Jane (Dame Joan Collins), an English girl he has met who accompanies him on a pleasure trip to Switzerland. He plans some hanky-panky on their various stops along the route, but Jane has other plans, as she is only with him because his car has a special-identification license plate and can go through customs without inspection. The car clears customs--as do the stolen million dollars she is smuggling. Sandro (Jacques Bergerac), her former boyfriend, is following them and plans to hijack the loot, leaving Jane empty-handed.

Title: 748. Río Hondo
description: A gang of bandits attacks the population of Río Hondo, shooting left and right; a man decides to act.

Title: 750. The Legend of Blood Mountain
description: A small-town newspaperman begins to suspect that a wave of murders committed in the area may not be the work of a serial killer but a monster.

Title: 752. Le majordome
description: Leopold, valet De Chambre of the Advocate General of Royssac, began to study the penal code and becomes, during his leave, judge in a court of the "middle".

Title: 753. Diamonds Are Brittle
description: Modest bank employee and passionate billiard player in his spare time, Bernard Noblet is bored stiff.

Title: 754. Orden de matar
description: A policeman who always had a fair and flawless sense of justice, after the murder of a friend becomes a ruthless executioner of criminals.

Title: 755. Purnima
description: Orphaned Purnima lives a poor lifestyle with her maternal uncle and cruel aunt. She is in love with Prakash and both plan to marry soon. when she goes to meet Prakash at his place of employment to seek a donation, she meets with Vasant, the son of the owner of Ratan Lal & Co., who takes an instant liking to her. Vasant convinces his mom, Sharda, to approach Purnima's aunt and convince her that he is the most suitable groom for her - by hook or by crook. Sharda succeeds in doing so, and shortly thereafter Purnima and Vasant get married. Purnima convinces Prakash to marry Vandana Mehra who is in love with him, and he does so. Shortly thereafter both Purnima and Vandana get pregnant and give birth to sons, Anil and Sunil respectively. Following a violent altercation, Vandana and Vasant are killed in a car accident, Ratan is forced to pay off Vasant creditors and as a result loses everything and moves into a small hut. He convinces Purnima to re-marry Prakash, but leave Anil with them, and she does so. Five years later, Sharda passes away, and Ratan asks Purnima to take Anil with her. Both Anil and Sunil get along well, however, one day Prakash sees Anil stealing money from his coat, and it is then he asks Purnima to make a choice between Anil and him. The question remains who will Purnima choose?

Title: 756. Watch the Birdie
description: Four girls in search of thrills find more than they bargained for when they get caught in a vice trap with no escape.

Title: 757. The Wild Affair
description: Office assistant Marjorie has doubts about marrying her fiance. On her last day at work before the wedding, male colleagues flirt with her while pretending to comfort her pre-wedding jitters, satirizing the British middle class.

Title: 758. Beautiful Duckling
description: The story of duck man Lin and his adopted daughter Hsiao-yue. Hsiao-yue knows nothing about her real descent, which Lin has been keeping secret from her. But one day, someone appears and changes her life.

Title: 759. Letti sbagliati
description: Four episodes: a traveler is enticed by train per bet; a professional wants to be alone with a woman he likes; a lawyer becomes the lover of an adversary; a man discovers his wife's infidelity after ten years.

Title: 761. Tridtsat tri
description: A rough factory worker of a distant rural town of Russia becomes a national celebrity, when it's discovered that his mouth bears 33 teeth. He is brought to Moscow, where he discovers a new world for him.

Title: 762. Shirotori
description: When two samurai warriors take on a job to take over the castle fort of an invading clan, they come across various allies along the road who aid in the mission.

Title: 763. Gunman's Hands
description: A reformed gunman returns to his earlier life seeking justice when the Castle brothers shoot his friends.

Title: 764. La bonne occase
description: The eccentric Comtesse de Saint-Plâs sells a black Citroën DS to car dealer Paul Souflé. He sells it to the young mathematics teacher Jacques Denzac who is about to marry.

Title: 765. The Bride Who Returned from Hell
description: A woman goes undercover as a governess to investigate the mysterious death of her sister while repairing her relationship with her niece.

Title: 768. Per un dollaro a Tucson si muore
description: A gang of outlaws takes domination of Tucson Arizona to anticipate for the arrival of a shipment of gold, with only a coalition of volunteer soldiers trying to fight them and recover the town.

Title: 771. Zhavoronok
description: During World War II, a squad of Soviet POWs steals a tank from Nazi test site and rushes into a desperate shoot over Germany.

Title: 772. Love & Kisses
description: Two 18-year-old students elope on the eve of high-school graduation and move in with his parents.

Title: 773. Chand Aur Suraj
description: After a disgraced man's accidental death, the lives of his family change drastically when they receive money from his insurance company.

Title: 774. Sweet Smell of Sex
description: A young woman arrives in New York to visit a friend and lands in one hot spot after another as she fends off the perverted advances from every man she meets.

Title: 775. Kdyby tisíc klarinetu
description: A military base. An awkward soldier. A statue of Bach. And suddenly all guns in the area change into music instruments. Great mystery is immediately found by TV station. And soon the military base becomes a stage for huge TV show.

Title: 776. Zoku Abashiri bangaichi
description: Tachibana has completed his three years in prison and returns to the streets. He and his old cell mate wants a new life as ex-prisoners, but by chance they come across some jewels from a bloody bank robbery.

Title: 777. Nobody Will Laugh
description: A bitter-sweet comedy about the problems which come with the avoidance of saying uncomfortable truths. An assistant professor gets lost in his lies as he attempts to postpone writing a negative review of an amateur fine arts essay.

Title: 778. City of Fear
description: A Canadian reporter gets mixed up in Cold-War politics, romance and espionage in Eastern Europe.

Title: 779. Tales of a Salesman
description: Herman dreams of being warned by his manager to increase his sales. As he contemplates his predicament, a mischievous poltergeist arrives to help him out.

Title: 780. Trzy kroki po ziemi
description: Three separate episodes, which are all based on magazine articles, centred on portraying the reality of living in 1960s Poland.

Title: 781. Raja Rammohan
description: 'Raja Ram Mohan' is the biopic of one of the greatest visionaries of India. Born in a Hindu Brahmin family Ram Mohan was always against idol worship and evil practices prevalent in Hindu religion. He believed in one god. He was reprimanded by his father and later mother for it but he never let go off his beliefs. He always had an estranged relationship with his mother due to these differences. He He's greatly moved when he sees young women being forced to die with their dead husbands. He starts his protest against this evil practice of 'sati'. He succeeds in passing the sati bill. But some orthodox staunch Hindus protest against the bill. He starts a new religious community the Brahmo Samaj. He goes to England to fight in favour of the sati bill. He promised the Delhi emperor to fight for his case. In return he would pay his expenses in the foreign land. Ram Mohan manages to get the reform bill passed and solves the emperor's problems even after being betrayed by the emperor. The hard work takes a toll o his health and he falls ill. But he is not ready to give up before getting the sati bill passed. After a hard struggle he succeeds in banning sati practice before he breathes his last.

Title: 783. Meiji ankokugai
description: A Japanese gangster is forced to work for the police to find out who is responsible for the robbery of a truck full of gold.

Title: 786. Rats ginakhavs, vegar nakhav
description: On his wedding day, Gogia discovers that his bride has been taken as a maid by a local nobleman. Gogia and his friends set out to rescue her.

Title: 787. Slalom
description: Lucio (Vittorio Gassman) sees his holiday on the Italian Alps interrupted when he is suddenly and unwillingly involved in an International plot involving fake dollar bills.

Title: 788. Latin Lovers
description: The film is composed of five episodes which depict Italians' love lives in the 1960s.

Title: 789. Sevismek yasak
description: A very young chemist invests a formula that can be revolutionize the whole market. At the beginnings nobody care the young chemist. Then competition is started to capture a formula. One woman changes everything.

Title: 791. Sa Bawa't Hakbang... Panganib
description: A mighty saga of men in war.

Title: 792. Haremde dört kadin
description: One of the earliest Turkish films to display lesbianism, tells the story of three women in Pasha's harem and a newcomer.

Title: 793. Spy in Your Eye
description: A leading American spy has a miniature camera surgically implanted in his eye, unbeknownst to him, and with it photographs secrets for the Russians, helping them gather information about a newly created death ray.

Title: 794. Tokugawa Ieyasu
description: In turbulent 16th-century Japan, the leaders of a minor fief have their child taken from them as a political hostage. His mother and his clan endure years of tribulations until he can return.

Title: 795. Vremya, vperyod!
description: A metallurgy plant in the 1930s tries to set a production record while a journalist follows their progress.

Title: 796. Gyerekbetegségek
description: A a comedy about a boy entering first grade and his classmates. We see their everyday life and their holidays, all through the eyes of a child. We find out that being a child is not as easy as adults make it out to be.

Title: 801. Alyas Batman at Robin
description: A Batman takeoff.

Title: 802. Mohabbat Isko Kahete Hain
description: Vijay and Rajni have been childhood sweethearts in a small town called Rajgarh. They did separate for a few years when Rajni and her maternal grandma, Leela, went to live in Calcutta. When Rajni returns, fully matured, both rekindle their romance, much to the chagrin of Kundan and his mom. Kundan's mom creates all kinds of misunderstandings between Vijay and Rajni, and Vijay's conduct, especially gambling, lying, and telling tall stories, does not help. Then Vijay is arrested by the police and held in jail. When he is discharged, he swears to turn his life around and be worthy of Rajni, leaves Rajgarh, finds employment in Durgapur as a truck driver. When he returns home he finds that Rajni and Leela have re-located to Calcutta where Rajni is to be married to a man named Ravi Shankar. A heartbroken Vijay goes to Calcutta to locate Rajni, but is unable to locate her. He falls into bad company, takes to alcohol, and then one day one of his new-found friends' abducts a woman - who turns out to be Rajni. When Vijay and Rajni come face to face there is nothing but hatred between them. Rajni walks out of Vijay's life. When they meet again in Dhanbad, Rajni is married to Ravi Shankar, who lives there with his sister, Manju. Watch what happens when Vijay re-enters Rajni's life and the reaction it has on Ravi and Manju.

Title: 803. Spaceflight IC-1: An Adventure in Space
description: A spaceship crewman plots a mutiny against the stern leader taking a group of people to settle on a new planet from Earth.

Title: 804. Uno straniero a Sacramento
description: Mike Jordan escapes from prison to vindicate his father and brother's death.

Title: 807. Great Luck
description: A young man travels to Tehran to claim an inheritance, unaware he has an exact lookalike. A criminal gang exploits this resemblance to steal the fortune, but with his lover's help, he uncovers the truth and has them arrested.

Title: 809. Klakson
description: A group of people go on a picnic in the mountains. Longing for some love and understanding, they try to get close to one another, but the barriers are insurmountable. Failing to pull through their nutshells of solitude, they get back to the city, the eternal desert.

Title: 810. Åsa-Nisse slår till
description: Åsa-Nisse has a lot of things going on. He is constantly inventing stuff and is also the leader of a hockey team and a pop concert arranger.

Title: 811. Der Frühling braucht Zeit
description: Even in the political environment of Marx and Engels, it happened that bosses took short cuts to complete safety critical work ahead of schedule. When an experienced and honest engineer, Heinz Solter, gets caught up in this he blows the whistle and suffers accordingly as the system tries to get him.

Title: 812. Across the River
description: A junk collector rescues a woman near his home across the lake from Manhattan who changes his life.

Title: 813. Thirteen Days to Die
description: Spy chase after the secret formula for uranium, U92, employing various sci-fi gadgetry, and physical violence.

Title: 814. Hot Skin, Cold Cash
description: A night in the life of a Time's Square hooker.

Title: 816. Pantalon Bankasi
description: A funny story about a poor guy who comes to Istanbul from his village with high hopes of getting rich.

Title: 817. Sunscorched
description: When the town sheriff backs down from outlaws, he is branded a coward. This melodramatic western follows his efforts to restore his good name, even though he himself was a former member of the gang.

Title: 818. Mme. Olga's Massage Parlor
description: Elaine takes over Olga's health club and uses it as a front for criminal activity. When some of the syndicate's jewels disappear, Elaine employs various gymnasium machines to torture female employees into fingering the guilty party.

Title: 819. House in Naples
description: Two friends go AWOL in Italy, World War II. One battles PTSD while the other double-crosses his way into a local crime syndicate.

Title: 820. Zatoichi's Revenge
description: After Zatoichi learns of his sensei's murder he uncovers a horrible conspiracy involving the local government and crime family.

Title: 821. The Eleanor Roosevelt Story
description: Richard Kaplan documents the life of one of America's most influential first ladies. Orphaned at age 10, Eleanor Roosevelt marries her fifth cousin, Franklin D. Roosevelt, in 1905. His election in 1932 allows Eleanor to step up to national prominence, battling for civil rights and visiting troops during World War II. After her husband's death, Roosevelt continues to advocate for human rights at the U.N., proving herself one of America's great humanitarians.

Title: 822. Odeyil Ninnu
description: A poor man living in Kerela follows his heart and instincts to save a child from the gutter, brings her up with love, only to find later in life that inevetibly she becomes spoilt and arrogant. However, lessons of universal life are finally learned together.

Title: 823. Faites vos jeux, mesdames
description: A famous American secret service agent tries to rescue a German 17-year-old prodigy scientist who has been captured by the Russians.

Title: 824. Titanic Waltz
description: Comedy/drama the life of an honest man who is pushed by his family to make policy

Title: 825. Operation Counterspy
description: A secret agent is sent to infiltrate the heavily guarded fortress of a madman bent on taking over the world.

Title: 826. El hijo de Gabino Barrera
description: After a man goes back to his father's, he has flashbacks of a man he never met and goes on a quest to discover who killed his father; meanwhile, a dangerous homesteader steals from the poor and keeps everything for himself.

Title: 827. Killer Spy
description: A secret agent, taking out the pretty critic of his published memoirs, finds a dying agent in a lift, and finds himself once more in spying and intrigue and danger.

Title: 828. The Revenge of Ivanhoe
description: William of Ivanhoe returns from the Crusades to free the Saxons from bondage in twelfth-century England. He claims the hand of Rowena and rescues her from danger.

Title: 829. Io uccido, tu uccidi
description: Six sketches with as many ways of murdering someone, and getting away with it.

Title: 830. Double Edged Crime
description: Andrés, son of a famous pianist, discovers the corpse of a tuner killed in his shop, located in the basement of his house. Then a suspect leaves, but in the fear of possible reprisals he doesn't tell anything to the police, only to his wife Laura. From that moment on, Andrés feels threatened and persecuted.

Title: 831. As Ilhas Encantadas
description: Pierre, a French sailor circa 1850, disembarks in a desert Atlantic island, and discovers a woman who had survived for many years her father and brother, dead while searching for mysterious valuables. The young couple discover paradise, and its end.

Title: 833. Lei Feng
description: Biography of the famous Chinese moral model Lei Feng.

Title: 834. The Diabolical Axe
description: El Santo is chased throughout 4 centuries by a mysterious masked man called El Encapuchado Negro.

Title: 835. The Lollipop Cover
description: An ex-boxer meets an abandoned 9-year-old girl, and together they hitchhike to California, where he must find a junkie who owes him money.

Title: 836. Gabino Barrera
description: A man begs his mother to tell him the real story of his late father, the man he never knew, and how and why he died. She proceeds to tell him, and the story unfolds in a flashback.

Title: 837. Fiebre de primavera
description: Three boys who live in the same neighborhood and go to the same college as three young girls start by harassing them and end up falling in love with them.

Title: 838. Run Home, Slow
description: After their criminal father is lynched, the Hagens find a treasure - but wander, starving in the desert.

Title: 839. María Rosa
description: In order to get María Rosa, the woman he is deeply in love with, Marsal murders a moneylender hated by all the people and casts suspicion on his friend Andrés, the husband of his beloved María Rosa. After being imprisoned Andrés, Marsal becomes the protector of María Rosa while waiting for the development of events.

Title: 840. Tokoloshe
description: A young African boy is rescued from a witchdoctor's death curse. He travels to the big city where a blind white man becomes his protector.

Title: 841. Echoes of Silence
description: Peter Emmanuel Goldman's rarely screened debut, an underappreciated landmark of the New American Cinema, chronicles the lives of twenty-somethings adrift in New York City, finding tremendous pathos in the smallest moments: a furtive glance across a museum gallery, girls putting on makeup, a stroll beneath the pulsing lights of Times Square marquees. Composed with a lo-fi purity and bereft of diegetic sound, its shadowy images of youthful flaneurs are paired with evocatively hand-painted title cards and a dynamic soundtrack drawn from the artist's LPs that, when combined, conjure up a ballad of dependency like none other.

Title: 842. Dudaktan Kalbe
description: Lamia and Kenan love each other. When they turn back from Paris they visit Kenan's uncle. Since then things do not go as expected.

Title: 843. Adhi Raat Ke Baad
description: Suspected for killing the wealthy father of his lover, a man, formerly known as Mr.X, goes on the run from the Police.

Title: 844. El Ouqalaa El Thalatha
description: Amin, a merchant, is haunted by nightmares of a young man attempting to kill him. When the man appears in real life seeking work, Amin learns he loves his daughter, Samia, and wants to marry her. Terrified, Amin opposes their relationship.

Title: 845. Pas de vacances pour les idoles
description: A movie which is between reality and fiction: a pop singer in the 1960's, ersatz teen idol, has adventures between his gigs.

Title: 846. Al-Mushaghib
description: Hamouda works in the port, becomes the head of workers, would like to establish a port workers' union, but this disrupts his interests with the exploiters of workers who sell stolen goods, and succeed in entering him into prison, preparing to marry Nousa, who helps her mother, so she sells gas water in the port, and when he leaves the prison, Hamouda finds Nouss waiting for him.

Title: 847. Andy
description: The story of a mentally handicapped middle-aged man and how he, and his elderly parents who must take care of him, manage to get along in New York City.

Title: 848. The Soul Snatcher
description: Aspiring model Kathy can't seem to get a break. The tide finally turns in her favor after Kathy meets the devil, who gives her a pair of magical gold shoes that enable Kathy to achieve her goal of becoming a famous and successful model. However, said deal with the devil comes at a significant spiritual price.

Title: 850. Ferien mit Piroschka
description: Thomas Laurends, son of a wealthy family, is appalled when his girlfriend Karin tells him through the flower that he wants to marry.

Title: 852. Tarahumara (Cada vez más lejos)
description: A worker of the Mexican Indigenist Institute tries to help the Tarahumara Indians to protect and keep their lands, but he must face corrupt landowners and politicians.

Title: 853. Schüsse im 3/4 Takt
description: B 501, a newly developed controller for missiles, has disappeared despite the strict surveillance.Phillippe Tissout is sent by his boss to Paris to take over the case.

Title: 854. Man Called Gringo
description: A group of outlaws take over a small frontier town and plan to stay awhile. A gunslinger arrives and decides to help the citizens take their community back, but the gang refuses to give up easily.

Title: 855. Coplan FX 18 casse tout
description: A French agent, who is sent to save an atomic scientist, uncovers a plot by terrorists and a secret atomic site in Turkey.

Title: 856. Halløj i himmelsengen
description: The young duke, Pierre is forced to spend his summer vacation with Latin studies. Luckily for Pierre his studies are interrupted by two young sweet girls.

Title: 857. Saigô no shinpan
description: Driven by greed and a desire for his cousin's wife, Jiro orchestrates a complex frame-up to have his cousin arrested for murder.

Title: 858. La primera aventura
description: Juan, Maria and Pepin's best friend is falsely accused of stealing some money. The three children decide to check it out and find the real thief.

Title: 860. Viagem aos Seios de Duília
description: Single retired civil servant decides to return to his hometown to meet his first and only love. But the woman he finds is just a spectre of his memory.

Title: 861. Peep Show
description: A conspiracy film involving a blackmail plot against a famous singer.

Title: 862. Rope Around the Neck
description: A misfit desperately looking for the murderer who has just killed his wife.

Title: 864. Sons of the Leopard
description: Penniless Baron Tulicò, nicknamed Leopard, abandons his mistress, with whom he's had two sons, and marries a rich woman. The mistress tries to have her rights established with the help of her sons.

Title: 866. Nympho
description: In suburban America, hidden desires and rivalries surface through wild swap parties and the provocative game Sex A-Go-Go.

Title: 867. Faraar
description: Calcutta-based Naval Officer Shankar Choudhry lives a wealthy lifestyle with his doctor dad, and mom. One day while returning home in a cab home from a Club, he comes an injured man, Shekhar, takes him home, has his dad nurse look after him, as well as goes to his home to notify his sister, Neela. Both Neela and he fall in love with each other. When Shekhar recovers, he returns home, and it is then that Shankar notices a change in Neela. When he questions her, she refuses to answer. Then Shekhar is shot and killed in his apartment. A Police Dectective Officer assigned to this homicide - has a lighter with the word 'S' engraved on it. This leads him to suspect three persons: One is a gangster named Shyam Sunder, second a delinquent runaway child, Sushil Kumar alias Daaku, who lives with his maternal uncle and aunt; and the third is none other than Shankar Choudhry himself.

Title: 868. Sangram
description: Two brothers, separated in childhood, fight for the love of a princess.

Title: 870. Jang bogo
description: Admiral Jang Bogo clears the sea of pirates and establishes safe trade routes between China, Japan and the ancient Korean kingdom of Shilla. Eventually however, his ambitions lead him to kill the king and set up a puppet leader to whom he tries to marry his daughter and secure the throne for his bloodline.

Title: 871. The Unfaithful
description: Ilham's (Nadia Lutfi) marriage to a highly successful - and often busy - lawyer (Mahmoud Mursi) is put to the test, and suspicions of infidelity arise.

Title: 872. Horasan'in üç atlisi
description: Ebu Muslim Horasani is the most outstanding hero in Horasan which is historical Turkish city. He fights against tyrant and he revenges from his mother and father's murderer.

Title: 873. Tarid el firdaos
description: Alish dies and is burred, where he is ascended to heaven, only to discover that the sum of his good deeds is equal to the sum of his bad deeds and he is neither among the people of Heaven nor among the people of Hell, so what now?

Title: 874. Cargando con el muerto
description: Moving company bozos are left holding the bag when bad guys hire them to transport a corpse.

Title: 875. El texano
description: A cacique hires thugs who abuse the townspeople. When thugs try to hang a young farmer, the Texan rescues him.

Title: 876. Dr. med. Hiob Prätorius
description: Medical professor Dr. med. Prätorius is loved by his patients and appreciated by his colleagues. His goal in life: to defeat the "bacillus of stupidity". His only effective remedy is humor. Pregnant patient Violetta Höllriegel seeks his advice. She has separated from her lover, but Praetorius implores her to carry the child to term. On leaving the clinic, she has an accident that looks suspiciously like a suicide attempt. The young woman is admitted to Prätorius' clinic. Despite the age difference, the two fall in love and marry. His personal and professional success arouses the envy of his colleague Professor Speiter. With the help of a detective agency, he discovers that at the beginning of his career, Prätorius had worked as a "medical practitioner" and had violated the dignity of the medical profession. Prätorius is summoned to appear before the medical association's court of honor. But when Prätorius reveals the secret of his past, the horror in the room gives way to laughter.

Title: 877. Satya Harishchandra
description: The story of a king Harishchandra who is known as " Satya Harishchandra "

Title: 878. L'Aube des damnés
description: Pamphlet movie. Anti-colonialist indictment on the history of Africa. In a colonized capital, students from various disciplines act out the words of popular storytellers and find that they are more realistic than university programs. After Independence, a group of young Algerians research in books, museums, the past of the colonized peoples of Africa and Asia. The National Center of Algerian Cinema which has just been created in 1963 will allow the construction of this film. An ambitious work, it was the homage of liberated Algeria to all those who fight against colonialism and oppression. In the great tradition of montage films, this film is supported by a commentary written in admirable language. All the epic breath and all the enthusiasm caused by the independence of Algeria is contained in the words and images of this film.

Title: 879. How Not to Rob a Department Store
description: To repay a debt, Marcel must commit a robbery in a large department store. Unfortunately his booty is intercepted by a gang of thugs.

Title: 880. Paris Secret
description: A shockumentary about what happens in Paris that even Parisian never see.

Title: 881. Dead Man's Chest
description: Two cynical young journalists attempt to expose the frailty of circumstantial evidence by planning to fake a murder, but the plan goes wrong.

Title: 882. Perdóname mi vida
description: On their wedding night she finds out that he married her for money (which is not true), there follows a series of misunderstandings when they each try to "see other people" during their honeymoon. With Mauricio Garces as the other guy.

Title: 883. The North and South
description: This wartime melodrama revolves around a woman caught between two men: her husband, a South Korean lieutenant, and her former lover, a North Korean officer who defects to come find her.

Title: 884. Domingo à Tarde
description: Reflections on life and death through the eyes of a medicine doctor, researcher on blood deseases, under the anguish of consulting a terminally ill young woman.

Title: 885. Fortress of the Dead
description: Guilt-ridden sole survivor of a unit wiped out on Corregidor in WW2 returns to the island 20 years later.

Title: 886. Fall of the Mohicans
description: As Alice and Cora Munro attempt to find their father, a British officer in the French and Indian War, they are set upon by French soldiers and their cohorts, Huron tribesmen led by the evil Magua. Fighting to rescue the women are Chingachgook and his son Uncas, the last of the Mohican tribe, and their white ally, the frontiersman Natty Bumppo, known as Hawkeye.

Title: 888. Giant of the Evil Island
description: A Spanish sea captain is sent to clean out Evil Island, from where pirate bands are raiding Spanish shipping under the leadership of a pirate named Moloch.

Title: 890. El amor no es pecado (El cielo de los pobres)
891. Neutron Battles the Karate Assassins
description: Superhero wrestler Neutron battles a gang of robotic assassins who use their hands and feet as deadly weapons.

Title: 893. The Girl with the Magic Box
894. Berlin um die Ecke
description: The story of tensions in a factory in communist east Germany and their society more generally - mostly through the adventures of two provocative factory workers.

Title: 896. A Class Picture of the CCAC Film Class of '65 Actually Taught by Bruce Conner in the Tradition of Lumière
897. Bedaag
description: Classmates Rajesh and Manju are in love with each other and their marriage is on card. But Manju's rich neighbor Jwalaprasad's daughter Lata, a spoiled lady, also wants to marry Rajesh. Manju's father falls sick of stomach tumor but she does not have Rs.5000 required for an operation. Unfortunately, Rajesh is out of station for some work. She goes to Jwalaprasad for help and finds his wife at home who gives her money but on a condition. Manju should accept unmarried Lata's illicit child as her own and should never disclose the truth to anyone. Helpless Manju agrees. But that money could not save her father who succumbs to his illness. Manju leaves the vicinity. Rajesh finds her after a couple of years with the kid and accuses her of deceiving him. He turns alcoholic. Jwalaprasad finds Manju and brings her at his home to serve Mrs.Jwalaprasad, who is a dumb handicap now because of an accident. Jwalaprasad asks Manju to convince Rajesh to marry Lata. Upon Manju's insistence, Rajesh agrees. During marriage rituals, Lata's house catches fire and Lata & her kid are trapped in. Rajesh saves them but Lata dies of an injury when she tries to stop Rajesh. Shocked Mrs.Jwalaprasad regains her voice and tells all about her atrocities on Manju, to everyone. Rajesh and Manju are united again.

Title: 898. Le voleur du Tibidabo
description: Following a mistake, a Frenchman selling ice cream in Barcelona, is taken for a burglar and chased by the police and various gangsters.

Title: 899. La conquista de El Dorado
description: A new judge and sheriff, along with support staff, arrive in town to clean up El Dorado's anarchic ways.

Title: 900. The Final Hour
description: This is not a feature film, but two episodes of the TV series "The Virginan" edited together.

Title: 901. The Bells Toll for the Barefooted
902. Son of the Mountains
description: While crossing the border near Kocadüzü, Sehmuz was shot by the fire opened by the gendarmerie. When they take a break, Hamo, who takes the opportunity to change his clothes a little later, kills the injured person who begs for a drop of water. Reason; A good friend is not a burden to a person anyway. Mehmet, left alone by his friend, is sentenced to 7 and a half years. In prison, on the first day, he becomes someone who is listened to because he taunts the head of the ward, Selamsiz. He has two friends here; Orphan and his dog Bidik. After 5 years of revenge, they will get rid of the four walls with a pardon and seek Hamo.

Title: 903. Pas de caviar pour tante Olga
description: Rosa, a housekeeper in a NATO office in Paris, steals a micro film for her lover whom she hopes to marry.

Title: 905. End Zone
description: A bullied high-school football player becomes a cannibal and eats his teammates after his jaw is broken by the team.

Title: 907. Transit
description: A man, mistakenly presumed dead, seizes the opportunity to create a new biography.

Title: 909. La Bohème
description: Puccini's well-known opera.

Title: 910. Toba no mesu neko
description: The first in a series of movies about a female yakuza.

Title: 911. Bheegi Raat
description: A spurned vengeance-seeking woman wreaks havoc in the life of an artiste and his lover.

Title: 913. Nishan
description: Twin princes separated at birth must foil an assassination attempt and take their rightful places as rulers of a kingdom.

Title: 915. Nympho: A Woman's Urge
description: Young Laura leaves her small town, where she has been subjected to sexual harassment and finally raped, for New York City. However, she turns into a nymphomaniac who sleeps with both men and women. After participating in a wild orgy, she tries to kill herself. She is saved in time and is sent for treatment to a famous psychiatrist who specializes in the treatment of nymphomania.

Title: 916. Una ráfaga de plomo
description: In the deserts of the Middle East, circa 1930s, a half-Arab-half-French adventurer named Aldar woos the Princess Yasmin while engaged in selling guns to warring factions.

Title: 917. The Myth
description: The nature of love and marriage is studied in two episodes.

Title: 918. Ku Klux Klan: The Invisible Empire
description: A documentary that traces the history of the Ku Klux Klan from its 1915 resurgence, inspired by the silent film "Birth of a Nation", through the post-World War II years. Scenes of KKK ceremonies, interviews with members, and speeches are shown.

Title: 919. Horasan'dan gelen bahadir
description: The another fight story against tyrant like Horasan'in Uc Atlisi.

Title: 922. Mumyeonggaui jibaeja
description: Hyeong-jin, a low level gangster, serves a prison sentence after taking the rap for his boss, "Shanghai". Shanghai fails to live up to his promise to take care of Hyeong-jin's family. Upon his release, Hyeong-jin swears reveange

Title: 923. The Last Wave
description: A most unusual film - grabbing the wild surf scene: the bodies, the boards, the waves...as told by Grant Rohloff with the voices of great surfers whose search for freedom has led them to the exciting world of surf, cycles and sensation.

Title: 924. Me vkhedav mzes
description: Khatia, a blind girl, sees only sunlight. Zurikela, young orphan boy, helps Khatia to have a normal life.

Title: 925. Luna
description: Story of the Moon told by scientists. The prospects of the Moon's future exploration by humans with elements of science fiction dramatization by actors in the final part of the film.

Title: 927. Desperate Mission
description: The American secret service sends agent Z 55 to Hong Kong with the task of continuing a mission started by a colleague of his, killed in mysterious circumstances.

Title: 928. The Forth Road Bridge
description: The construction of the Forth Road Bridge in Scotland from the initial survey to the official opening.

Title: 929. Bahu Beti
description: Watch the full movie, Bahu Beti, only on Eros Now. Bahu Beti is a 1965 Indian Hindi film, directed by T. Prakash Rao and produced by Rajkamal Kalamandir (PVT) Ltd. The film stars Ashok Kumar, Mala Sinha, Joy Mukherjee and Mehmood in lead roles. The film had musical score by Ravi.

Title: 930. Surya Tapa
description: Another call on "I married a Dead Man" but with a change- the family hated the DIL and didn't want her, but wanted the child, the heir. The woman and the child had been attached and couldn't live apart.

Title: 933. Las tapatías nunca pierden
description: An heiress and her friends disguise themselves as gypsies to confront squatters occupying her inherited estate.

Title: 937. Al Moshaghiboun
description: Amin, out of prison, meets Youssef, a gang leader, asking for his money. Youssef tells him that Nadia stole his money. In order to get closer to her, Amin and his friends, the 3 musicians, ask Nadia if they can work at her night club.

Title: 940. Ironfinger
description: A Japanese-Frenchman on vacation is caught up in a criminal conspiracy along with a female bomb expert and a bumbling Detective.

Title: 941. Peraste tin proti tou minos
description: A young debt collector realises that chasing overdue payments for a living is hard. When she encounters a tough nut to crack, sparks fly, and love gets in the way. But can the debt collector fall for the debtor?

Title: 942. Seven Days in a Week
description: Seven days, or rather evenings and nights, in the life of Jenka (Stanislava Bartošová), a young good-looking nurse. Jenka is attractive to men and enjoys their company, but there is a limit beyond which she won't go, since she is faithful to her Filip, who is doing his military service. On Sunday the girl awaits Filip to arrive on a short period of leave, but instead his friend Míla (František Němec) turns up and apologizes for Filip, who has to stay in the barracks.

Title: 943. Shoot to Kill
description: A band of outlaws terrorizes Las Cruces. A foreigner saves a ranch owner from being kidnapped by them, who in turns makes him the manager. But things aren't as they seem.

Title: 944. Ryuji's Journey: The Crest of Man
description: The new head (Ryuji) of the powerful Oshima-Murata yakuza clan faces danger from an evil rival who is out for blood and revenge in this classic samurai historical tale.

Title: 945. Dead End
description: After serving time for manslaughter, a photojournalist faces a deadly extortion plot. A woman from his past in Paris takes his wife hostage over a secret tape, forcing a violent and fatal confrontation to save her.

Title: 946. Noor Mahal
description: A story of a revenge taken by Vir Singh in greediness to get the throne of his brother, who was the real king.

Title: 947. Serseri asik
description: The love story of a singer woman and a man from a wealthy family.

Title: 953. The Journals of Lewis and Clark
description: An hour-long color program commemorating and recreating the Lewis and Clark Expedition.

Title: 955. White Mountains
description: While on the run in the mountains from the authorities, a poor peasant tries to save a widow of the WWII soldier from an arranged marriage.

Title: 956. The Cats
description: A group of women are work-mates at a laundry. Rike is spreading a rumor about the manager Marta, a rumor that Marta is gay and that she once tried to seduce Rike. This leads to an explosive situation at the work-place.

Title: 957. Tight Skirts, Loose Pleasures
description: Catherine Guérande (Valeria Ciangottini), a 19-year-old attractive Parisian girl, decides to become a prostitute after a messy love affair. She did not count on Pornotropos (Jean Yanne), a brutal racketeer who runs the profitable business of model agencies, cabarets, and camping sites, backed by Thanatos (Jean-Marie Fertey), his brother, who runs the mugging and murder side of their business. Pornotropos is not taking it well that a freelancer is around reducing his profits, and he sets his girls to harass and beat her up. Catherine does not take his mistreatment and moves to another brothel. But luck has it that an old man (Roger Karl) dies in her room, and that he was the owner of a marketing agency. Paul (Jacques Destoop), a young and handsome executive in his company, decides to investigate the shady causes of death of his late boss, and when Paul meets Catherine it's love at first sight.

Title: 958. Ruf der Wälder
description: The aged poacher Gustl Wegrainer tells the story of the dog Bella, who is just as old as him, and lives as a puppy in a big city, being picked up by the Italian guest worker Marcello Scalzi.

Title: 960. Se non avessi più te
description: A young singer secretly gets married since he does not want to let his fans down. After a while the gutter press make up a love story which seriously worries his young bride.

Title: 961. Game for Three Losers
description: A politician is set up by his secretary and blackmailed by her brother.

Title: 962. Kak vas teper nazyvat?
description: Taking advantage of the panic after the explosion of the oil depot in Posolsk, someone managed to get acquainted with the secret documents of General von Rogge.

Title: 964. Le faux pas
description: During a walk along the cliffs not far from Marseille, Elisa Langerot sees her husband slip and fall to his death. Inexplicably, Elisa flees the scene of the accident, stops a passing driver and tells him a made-up story about a stolen car, concealing her husband's death. Feeling sorry for the girl, the driver, Philippe Morçot, gives her a lift and later lets her stay at his house. The good deed, however, doesn't go unpunished, and soon Philippe is drawn into Elisa's twilight world of fantasies, lies and paranoia.

Title: 965. Puerto Rico en carnaval
description: Knowing the problems that brings Carnival, the airport director appoints a team to deal with a threat from an anonymous letter.

Title: 968. I'm Not Worthy of You
description: Osman is in love with the daughter of a wealthy family, Türkan, but he hesitates to open up. Unlike his brother, Ekrem is after Türkan's money and tricks her with promises of marriage. However, Osman is aware of his brother's intentions.

Title: 969. Karaoglan: Altay'dan Gelen Yigit
description: Karaoglan is a young Turk that is a bouncer to protect the Anatolian land from the Mongolian occupation. Defends Anatolian lands against Camoka.

Title: 970. Non son degno di te
description: Gianni takes leave from the military to launch his recording career in Rome and becomes suspicious when another man tries to win over his fiance Carla.

Title: 971. Impossible on Saturday
description: Six sons of a recently deceased Jewish Casanova plan to receive their inheritance, and must convene in Israel and recite a Kaddish (memorial prayer) for their dad.

Title: 972. I due parà
description: Two penniless Italian buskers want to go to the USA but get on the wrong ship and end up in South America in a concentration camp where they are rescued by American parachutists from. Afterwards they become big shots in the States but their dream comes to an end : they are sent to fight in Vietnam

Title: 973. Forty Acre Feud
description: Overlooked when the Tennessee legislature reapportioned the state, the 40-acre community of Shagbottom is discovered and notified to elect a state representative. The ensuing power struggle results in both fussin' and feudin'.

Title: 974. Tajimara
description: Two couples of brothers and two different stories that show the complications of the incestuous relationships between them.

Title: 976. Dali in New York
description: Filmmaker Jack Bond and Salvador Dali got together at Christmas 1965 to make Dali in New York, a highly entertaining film. Dali devoted two weeks of his life to creating extraordinary scenes for the film, performing "manifestations" with a plaster cast. A thousand ants and one million dollars in cash. When he confronts the feminist writer, Jane Arden, sparks fly. "You are my Slave! I am not your slave. Everybody is my slave." Dali recalls his meeting with Freud, "The last human relationship ever" About his wife, 'But for Gala I would be lying in a gutter somewhere covered with lice" Jim Desmond's dazzling cinematography captures the great artist painting as Flamenco virtuoso Manitas de Plata performs. Dali in New York is a rare treat for anyone who loves film and the living theatre of Dali's surreal universe.

Title: 978. Radishes and Carrots
description: One day, a company executive learns that his younger brother, whom he had guaranteed for, embezzled company funds. To save the situation, the executive gives his brother his life savings.

Title: 979. Los cuervos están de luto
description: The family of a dying man celebrates his wake while the man is still alive, showing their darker, selfish ambitions and trying to take the best part of the inheritance.

Title: 980. Do Not Come Back Along the Same Road
description: Another story about the great animosity between the Bosnians and Slovenians; this is about Bosnians whose misery and poverty forced them to adopt their fortune in Slovenia in the search for happiness. The film follows a group of Bosnians who have come to work in construction as seasonal workers, their torment and bullying by Slovenes, and their struggle for survival.

Title: 982. Veneri al sole
description: Three episodes: In the first one a girl gets a journalist to help her recover a case with some precious designs in it; in the second a worker keen on helping his boss gets him into trouble instead and in the third one a shy boy who tries to impress women pretending he is tough ends up in hospital and falls in love with a nurse.

Title: 984. Ektuku Chhoan Lage
description: This movie about two friends, Anil and Tapan, their bond each other more then themselves. Anil is a struggling music director and Tapan is a struggling story writer. Studently they meet Anita, a rich girl, who has run away from her house.

Title: 985. To prosopo tis imeras
description: After winning a trip to Athens, a happy merchant becomes entangled in a misunderstanding, when two rival smuggling rings believe that he is the liaison entrusted with delivering a statue to a collector. Will he get out of the tight spot?

Title: 986. Kuroi tobakushi
description: Koji Himuro is a make-out artist with unparalleled gambling skills. Shortly after his return to Tokyo, he is invited to attend a reception that is actually an undercover gambling operation run by an international gambling syndicate.

Title: 987. Rapazes de Táxis
description: João and Jaime work as taxi drivers for the same company. But, once the company's vault is robbed by Raul, the manager's son, João is the one to blame.

Title: 988. From Istanbul, Orders to Kill
description: A starving writer is offered $20,000 by an old friend in the intelligence service to pose as "Felix," an international smuggler, because the writer looks exactly like this Felix.

Title: 992. Country Music on Broadway
description: A country music show comes to Broadway with the only big screen appearance of the legendary Hank Williams.

Title: 995. Ih, du forbarmende
description: An English photographer is found dead in his studio in Copenhagen, Denmark. Scotland Yard sends Jim Pond to investigate the case. A gang of criminals expects him.

Title: 997. Shin kurama tengu
description: The film is set in Kyoto at the end of the Tokugawa period, when there is a fierce clash between the supporters of the Emperor, who are fighting for the overthrow of the Shogunate, and the Shinsengumi squad, who are chasing them.

Title: 998. Fagr Yom gedid
description: Nayla, a middle-aged aristocrat steeped in debt, is deeply unhappy in her marriage and struggles to find her place in post-revolutionary 1960s Egypt. A glimmer of hope appears in the form of working-class college student Tareq.

Title: 999. Broken Sabre
description: In the 1880s Jason McCord travels across the country trying to prove he's not a coward because his Army career and West point graduate came to an end when he was thrown out of the army after being falsely accused of cowardice.

Title: 1000. La dama de Beirut
description: Isabel is a beautiful singer with great aspirations but persistent bad luck. After serving time in prison for a crime she did not commit, she lands a singing gig at a dive in Barcelona where she meets Xandro "The Greek" and his partner lover Gloria. The couple is posing as entertainment promoters but they are really running a prostitution ring based in Beirut. They offer Isabel a contract to perform in "night clubs" in the Mideast and she accepts eager to get away. Upon arrival in Beirut, Isabel and other girls are sped away to a luxurious villa where they discover the real intentions of the pseudo-promoters. They are expected to sing and dance but also to engage in sexual activities with the rich clients that patronize the place. Isabel pretends to go along with the situation but starts devising a plan to get away.
